label: Batch
description: Multiple operations in a single transaction.

methods.name: sendmany
methods.description: Build and broadcast a transaction with multiple covenant operations.

response.name: txid
response.description: Transaction hash of the combined transaction.

example.request: fbdctl --wallet main sendmany open example, bid other 5.0 10.0, none fb1q... 1.5

methods.notes: Actions: open, bid, reveal, redeem, register, update, renew, transfer, finalize, revoke, none. Without a name, reveal/redeem/renew/finalize apply to all eligible names.
